plugins.name: lawdiver
plugins.description: Search and verify U.S. federal and state caselaw, statutes, and citations with LawDiver. Jurisdiction-scoped research, full opinion text, citation checks, and good-law / treatment signals.

skills.name: caselaw-research
skills.description: Search U.S. federal and state caselaw in LawDiver with a required jurisdiction, then summarize hits with real citations and good-law flags. Use when the user wants case research, case law search, or authorities on a legal issue. Do not use for non-legal web search, drafting filings, or inventing citations.

skills.name: check-citation-good-law
skills.description: Verify U.S. case, statute, or specialty citations against the LawDiver corpus and report match status plus good-law / treatment signals when available. Use when the user asks if a cite is real, still good law, or overruled. Do not invent treatment signals.

skills.name: retrieve-opinion
skills.description: Resolve a U.S. case citation or name in LawDiver and load the full opinion body text for quoting and pin cites. Use when the user wants the full case, opinion text, or quotes from a known citation. Do not use for free-form topic search (use caselaw-research) or non-legal lookups.

skills.name: retrieve-statute
skills.description: Retrieve full U.S. statute, regulation, or court-rule section text from LawDiver by Bluebook citation or authority key. Use when the user asks for the text of a code section, regulation, or court rule. Do not use for caselaw search or inventing statutory language.

skills.name: setup
skills.description: Guide the user through authenticating the LawDiver MCP connector bundled with this plugin. Use when the plugin is newly installed, LawDiver tools fail with auth errors, or the user asks how to connect LawDiver.
